## Flagship Digital Products
1. **HealthDost: Rural AI Healthcare**
   - Health-tech progressive web application designed for rural Central India with restricted clinic access.
   - Multimodal Gemini 2.5 Flash medical triage and clinical report generation.
   - Deterministic 85% confidence rule: handoff to AI Doctor Chat if triage confidence falls below 85%.
   - Peer-to-peer WebRTC video consultation using browser localStorage signalling.
   - OpenStreetMap Overpass API for emergency hospital locator and SOS pre-notifications.
2. **Crowdsourced Civic Issue Reporting and Resolution System**
   - Municipal grievance resolution platform with transparent 5-stage tracking (Reported → Verified → Assigned → In Progress → Resolved).
   - Academic minor project (Team of 5, July–Dec 2026) adhering to formal RGPV UML standards (Use Case, DFD 0/1/2, ERD).
